name: DON'T LET HIM IN [NEW MONSTER]
desc:
Work together to survive the night while it circles the house, studies your mistakes, and searches for a way in.

Keep the floodlights powered. Watch the doors and windows. Restore the breaker when the power fails. Light keeps it away, but one vulnerable entrance is all it needs.

If it gets inside, the house goes dark.

Hide. Stay quiet. Survive until morning.

📱🥽🎮 ALL DEVICES SUPPORTED

🎧 Headphones strongly recommended
🎙️ Best experienced with voice chat
🖼️ Highest quality graphics recommended

The Locust, Boiled One, and Boy and the Bath characters are all originally created by DoctorNowhere.

end

local function noclip()
    if noclipActive then
        local c = getChar()
        for _, v in pairs(c:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CanCollide = false end end
    end
end

local function getPartFromPath(path)
    if not path then return nil end
    local current = game
    for _, partName in pairs(string.split(path, ".")) do
        if current then current = current:FindFirstChild(partName) end
    end
    return current
end

local function teleportToSpot(spotKey)
    local spot = SPOTS[spotKey]
    if not spot or not spot.path then return end
    
    local part = getPartFromPath(spot.path)
    if part then
        local targetCFrame = part.CFrame
        local root = getRoot()
        
        root.CFrame = targetCFrame
        root.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
        
        local startTime = tick()
        local connection
        connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if tick() - startTime < 2 then
                if (root.Position - targetCFrame.Position).Magnitude > 5 then
                    root.CFrame = targetCFrame
                end
            else
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
        end)
        
        task.spawn(function() 
            game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
                Title = "By Alo's", 
                Text = "Teleported to " .. spot.name .. "!", 
                Duration = 3
            }) 
        end)
    else
        task.spawn(function() 
            game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
                Title = "By Alo's", 
                Text = "Spot not found, This is for " .. spot.game .. " btw", 
                Duration = 3
            }) 
        end)
    end
end

local locustHighlight = nil
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if fovCircle then
        fovCircle.Position = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
        fovCircle.Visible = aimbotActive
    end

    if brightActive or fogErased then
        Lighting.FogEnd = 999999
        Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        Lighting.ClockTime = 14
        
        if brightActive then
            Lighting.Brightness = 2.5
            Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        end
    end

    local locust = workspace:FindFirstChild("Locust")
    if locust then
        if espActive then
            if not locustHighlight or locustHighlight.Parent ~= locust then
                if locustHighlight then locustHighlight:Destroy() end
                locustHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                locustHighlight.Adornee = locust
                locustHighlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                locustHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.3
                locustHighlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                locustHighlight.Parent = locust
            end
        else
            if locustHighlight then locustHighlight:Destroy() locustHighlight = nil end
        end

        if aimbotActive then
            local targetPart = locust:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not targetPart and locust:FindFirstChild("Visual") then
                targetPart = locust.Visual:FindFirstChild("LocustTorso") or locust.Visual:FindFirstChild("LocustHead")
            end
            
            if targetPart then
                local targetPos = targetPart.Position
                local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPos)
                
                if onScreen then
                    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
                    local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    
                    if dist < fovCircle.Radius then
                        local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
                        rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {getChar(), Camera}
                        rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                        local rayResult = workspace:Raycast(Camera.CFrame.Position, (targetPos - Camera.CFrame.Position), rayParams)
                        
                        if rayResult and rayResult.Instance:IsDescendantOf(locust) then
                            local aimCFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, targetPos)
                            Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(aimCFrame, 0.5)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    else
        if locustHighlight then locustHighlight:Destroy() locustHighlight = nil end
    end
end)

        dragging = true; dragStart = input.Position; startPos = iconFrame.Position
    end
end)
iconFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        iconFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
end)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() mainFrame.Visible = false; iconFrame.Visible = true end)
iconFrame.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() mainFrame.Visible = true; iconFrame.Visible = false end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if not (StateAutoFuse or StateEspPlayers or StateEspBicho or StateAutoCollect) then
            task.wait(1)
        else
            task.wait(0.6)
            
            for _, subObj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if StateAutoFuse and (subObj.Name:lower():find("fuse") or subObj.Name:lower():find("breaker") or subObj.Name:lower():find("caixa")) then
                    local click = subObj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector")
                    if click then fireclickdetector(click) end
                end

                local playerAssociado = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(subObj)
                if StateEspPlayers and playerAssociado and playerAssociado ~= LocalPlayer then
                    if not subObj:FindFirstChild("PlayerESP") then
                        local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                        Highlight.Name = "PlayerESP"
                        Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
                        Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.3
                        Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                        Highlight.Parent = subObj
                    end
                end

                if StateEspBicho and subObj:IsA("Model") and subObj:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and not playerAssociado then
                    if not subObj:FindFirstChild("BichoESP") then
                        local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                        Highlight.Name = "BichoESP"
                        Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                        Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.3
                        Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                        Highlight.Parent = subObj
                    end
                end

                if StateAutoCollect and (subObj:IsA("Tool") or subObj:IsA("ClickDetector") or subObj:IsA("TouchTransmitter") or 
                    subObj.Name:lower():find("token") or subObj.Name:lower():find("coin") or 
                    subObj.Name:lower():find("item") or subObj.Name:lower():find("key") or 
                    subObj.Name:lower():find("bateria") or subObj.Name:lower():find("fuse")) 
                    and not subObj:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Character) then
                    
                    local partAlvo = subObj:IsA("BasePart") and subObj or subObj.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    if partAlvo then
                        criarEspTexto(partAlvo, subObj.Name:upper(), Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255), "ItemESP")
                        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and subObj:IsA("BasePart") then
                            local meuHRP = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                            if (meuHRP.Position - subObj.Position).Magnitude < 45 then
                                firetouchinterest(meuHRP, subObj, 0)
                                firetouchinterest(meuHRP, subObj, 1)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
